question: Which dwarf planet orbits the sun in 310 years at a distance between 38.5 to 53 AU?
solution:
The Correct is Answer __**Makemake**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• Makemake is a distant dwarf planet located in the Kuiper Belt, a region beyond Neptune's orbit. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 1. Makemake - NASA Science 
 
 

 
 
 [IMAGE: https://encrypted-tbn1.gstatic.com/favicon-tbn?q=tbn:ANd9GcQi1gJqgTD5bk_0P17fdMw5JOA6-AXp8ras5bKgzAxxToHUbzOFnDo4WcFSPbCVkttbHPaHrAmDd0VN_s4dkpVmNLV9fpPv0JKzqg] 
 science.nasa.gov
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• It has an orbital period of approximately 310 years and an average distance from the **Sun of about 45.5 astronomical units** (AU).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Makemake was discovered in 2005 and is named after the Polynesian creation deity. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 1. Makemake - NASA Science 
 
 

 
 
 [IMAGE: https://encrypted-tbn1.gstatic.com/favicon-tbn?q=tbn:ANd9GcQi1gJqgTD5bk_0P17fdMw5JOA6-AXp8ras5bKgzAxxToHUbzOFnDo4WcFSPbCVkttbHPaHrAmDd0VN_s4dkpVmNLV9fpPv0JKzqg] 
 science.nasa.gov
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• It is one of the largest known dwarf planets in the Solar System, with a diameter estimated to be around **1,430 kilometres**.
 
• Makemake is believed to have a cold, icy surface and is thought to be a potentially habitable world due to the possibility of subsurface oceans.
